feedback: Based on earlier races with similar sensor layouts and chassis dimensions, the controller needs to compensate for moderate sensor size and spacing by emphasizing outer sensors in weights and using a moderate base speed to avoid stalling or overshoot. If the next race shows high line loss events or poor progress, consider increasing sensor size to 0.016 m to improve line detection coverage or adjusting sensor positions to cover a wider lateral range. If the robot oscillates or has high rms error, reduce kp or increase kd to improve stability. If the robot stalls or completes slowly, increase base_speed or reduce ki to avoid integral windup.
requested_changes: sensor_size to 0.016 to improve line detection coverage if line loss events are high (evidence: previous races with larger sensors showed fewer line losses)
adjust sensor_positions x-coordinates to [-0.05, -0.025, 0, 0.025, 0.05] to widen sensor coverage if progress is low (evidence: wider sensor spread improved progress in earlier tests)
reduce kp to 7.0 and increase kd to 3.0 if rms_error or oscillations are high (evidence: higher kd damped oscillations in prior runs)
